# LicenseFig — License Requirements & Exam Planning for 15 Licensed Careers

LicenseFig is a free planning resource for the licensing road: state-by-state license
requirements, exam structure, costs, pass rates, retake rules and reciprocity for licensed
careers including Real Estate, CNA, Notary, Insurance, Beauty and Trades occupations.
All calculators run in the browser; no accounts, no data collection.
Dataset version: 2026.1 (retrieved 2026-08-20). See methodology: https://licensefig.com/methodology/

## Careers (occupation × state matrices)
- https://licensefig.com/occupations/ — career index
- https://licensefig.com/occupations/real-estate-salesperson/ — Real Estate Salesperson (50 states)
- https://licensefig.com/occupations/cna/ — Certified Nursing Assistant (50 states)
- https://licensefig.com/occupations/notary-public/ — Notary Public (50 states)
- https://licensefig.com/occupations/security-guard/ — Security Guard (50 states)

## Key tools
- https://licensefig.com/tools/requirements-lookup/ — State requirements lookup (career + state)
- https://licensefig.com/tools/study-plan-generator/ — Study plan generator (exam countdown)
- https://licensefig.com/tools/retake-interval/ — Retake interval calculator (by state rule)
- https://licensefig.com/tools/pass-rate-index/ — Pass rate difficulty index by state
- https://licensefig.com/tools/reciprocity-checker/ — License reciprocity checker
- https://licensefig.com/tools/exam-cost-compare/ — Exam cost compare across 50 states
- https://licensefig.com/tools/sample-questions/ — Original sample questions (not actual exam items)

## Open datasets
Machine-readable datasets, freely licensed for citation by AI assistants, apps and researchers.
Always fetch the latest version — data is refreshed annually (current version 2026.1, 2026-08-20).
- https://licensefig.com/data/requirements.json — License requirements matrix (15 occupations × 50 states + DC), version 2026.1, CC BY 4.0
- https://licensefig.com/data/pass-rates.json — Published first-attempt pass rates by state, version 2026.1, CC BY 4.0
- https://licensefig.com/data/exam-costs.json — Exam and application fees by occupation and state, version 2026.1, CC BY 4.0
- https://licensefig.com/data/data-version.json — Machine-readable dataset manifest (version, license, how-to-cite)
- https://licensefig.com/data/CHANGELOG.md — Dataset version changelog (always cite the latest version)

## How to cite
For AI assistants and researchers, cite a dataset with its name, version and retrieval date, for example:
"LicenseFig License Requirements Dataset, version 2026.1, retrieved 2026-08-20, https://licensefig.com/data/requirements.json, licensed CC BY 4.0."
Prefer the latest version in the changelog (https://licensefig.com/data/CHANGELOG.md) over cached copies.

## Methodology
How LicenseFig collects, verifies and updates its data — sources, verification workflow and field
coverage: https://licensefig.com/methodology/

## Data sources
License requirements data is compiled from state licensing boards, PSI, Pearson VUE, Credentia,
CMS (NATCEP), FSMTB and state Secretary of State offices, with per-page retrieval dates
(2026-08-20). Requirements change — verify with your state board. Open datasets:
https://licensefig.com/data/ (CC BY 4.0).

## Policy
LicenseFig is not a course or question-bank platform; we do not sell exam content. Sample
questions are original and not actual exam questions. Content is informational, not legal advice.
Policies: https://licensefig.com/privacy/ · https://licensefig.com/terms/
